algorithms.name: SRECE (noise-covariance weighting)
algorithms.result: lite form (per-overpass background-annulus noise -> 1/sigma^2 weights, with monsoon exclusion): part of the combined method that lifts every known emitter above 3 sigma (R4: +wind 5.9 -> combined 5.4 t/h floor). Variogram/correlation-length form not built.

algorithms.name: ABD (albedo/aerosol bias decorrelation)
algorithms.result: mean z over 5 emitters 3.74 -> 4.06; floor 5.4 -> 5.0 t/h

algorithms.name: PW-HHP (Helmholtz projection of winds)
algorithms.result: national noise fell 29% but blind recovery fell 4 -> 3 of 4 (Jawaharnagar lost). Unweighted variant: the gridded product has no column-mass per wind.

algorithms.name: NDC (null-divergence wind calibration)
algorithms.result: replaced by per-site ERA5 100 m/10 m transport factor (gamma) + OBC slope, which are independently measurable

algorithms.name: MSFD (multi-species flux divergence, CO leg)
algorithms.result: CO co-retrieved in the same pixels, stacked with the same winds and operator: detected above its own pseudo-site null at all 5 emitters; runs on every site as the co-emission check, with its false-pass rate measured each run. NO2 leg not ingested

algorithms.name: KPW (Kuttaka phase-weighted stacking)
algorithms.result: each overpass weighted so every sub-pixel phase of the site counts equally: mean z over 5 emitters 4.06 -> 4.37; floor 4.96 -> 4.76 t/h. Phases are measured per overpass; the kuttaka orbit-repeat prediction is used for planning only

algorithms.name: PSSI (sparse + smooth inversion)
algorithms.result: lite form (positive sparse sources blurred by the footprint + smooth regional field) on the 3.4-year divergence map: blind recovery 0 vs 3 for the screen; sign-flipped false detections 40 vs 35. Paddy/livestock physics priors not ingested

algorithms.name: DiverSR core (footprint-drizzled super-resolved stacking)
algorithms.result: each pixel spread over its real footprint before stacking: the step that lifts every known emitter above 3 sigma (R4: +wind floor 5.9 -> combined 5.4 t/h)

algorithms.name: DiverSR off-grid peak refinement
algorithms.result: quadratic sub-cell peak fit on the national field: mean blind distance 7.9 -> 8.7 km

algorithms.name: WIT (wind-invariance test)
algorithms.result: false-reject rate 25% on centred injections (needs <= 15%); power 4% against a neighbour at the disk edge (needs >= 50%). Divergence within a disk is already nearly wind-invariant.

algorithms.name: MRI (monsoon residual imputation)
algorithms.result: policy adopted without the imputation: monsoon months are reported as unobserved, never filled

algorithms.name: MC-FOD (moisture-coupled landfill decay)
algorithms.result: needs soil-moisture and waste-input series per landfill

algorithms.name: PKTD (process-kernel temporal decomposition)
algorithms.result: per-site monthly series are too sparse after monsoon exclusion (0-12 overpasses/month)

algorithms.name: EIV-CRF (CO/CH4 ratio fingerprint)
algorithms.result: with the final method the ratio's 68% interval clears the combustion boundary at 3 of 5 emitters (khajod, deonar, jharia; gate 3, passed narrowly; it failed at 2 of 5 before KPW). Reported per site as process evidence (decay vs burning), never as proof of a sector

algorithms.name: EFA (evidence-fusion attribution, land-use leg)
algorithms.result: top sector correct for 5 of 7 reference sites from OpenStreetMap facilities within 25 km; 0 confidently wrong

algorithms.name: OBC (injection-recovery calibration)
algorithms.result: recovery slope 0.992 (R^2 0.9999, site CV 0.3%); detection probability 5 t/h: 8%, 10 t/h: 46%, 20 t/h: 100%, 40 t/h: 100%

algorithms.name: BY-FDR confirmed-tier gate (with independent corroboration)
algorithms.result: family of 6 references + 36 fake candidates: BY-FDR alone admits 2 fakes (coastal, Surat window); adding the independent second-estimator check admits 1 of 36 and confirms 4 of 5 real emitters. In the inventory the re-detection-in-disjoint-years check also applies

algorithms.name: WRPI (warming-per-rupee priority)
algorithms.result: transparent accounting over cited constants (AR6 GWP20, EPA landfill MAC, IEA fossil MAC) with Monte Carlo; x P(real)

algorithms.name: VOIT (value-of-information tasking)
algorithms.result: backtest: of sites not yet significant in 2023-24, the top third by VOI were re-detected in 2025-26 54% of the time vs 18% for the rest (Fisher p 0.025, n 41); the inventory recommends its top 5 for a high-resolution overpass
